title: A Gleason-Kahane-Żelazko Theorem for $H^p_{α, β}$ spaces
summary: We study two entities that have proved to be of interest and importance in their own right viz. the $H^p_{α, β}$ spaces and the classical Gleason-Kahane-Żelazko (GKZ) theorem. We establish a GKZ-type theorem on the $H^p_{α, β}$ spaces by identifying a natural class of functions serving as the counterpart of invertible elements, and proving that every continuous linear functional nonvanishing on this class is a point evaluation.
